scope: 审核并完善 docs/FP_NEON_PIPELINE_PLAN.md；校准当前 RTL、P7 协议、性能路线和 A10 full-FP 综合事实，收敛首选微架构、阶段 DAG、量化门、验证矩阵、风险与回退。

result.preferred_architecture: single-outstanding blocking transaction with one shared 64-bit lane engine; optional two-lane/in-order throughput work only after one-lane fit/STA
plan_phases: FP-P1 transaction wrapper and core single-owner handshake
FP-P2 shared one-lane NEON slot sequencing
FP-P3 iterative sqrt/div and common path consolidation
FP-P4 functional/performance and controlled PPA sweep

audit_findings.finding: T-20260902-010 synthesis estimates 482334 ALMs for a 427200-ALM device; full-FP fitter/STA were not run.
audit_findings.resolution: Treat synthesis as reproducibility evidence only; require shared-engine resource gate before fitter.

audit_findings.finding: Current lcvex_neon_fp elaborates four complete lcvex_fp_scalar instances while core elaborates another scalar instance.
audit_findings.resolution: Make one shared lane engine the preferred first implementation and prove sharing in Quartus hierarchy reports.

audit_findings.finding: Current scalar interface has valid/div_busy/div_done, not a request/response ready-valid contract; FSQRT remains a 64-round combinational restoring loop.
audit_findings.resolution: Add a clocked one-owner transaction wrapper before structural/iterative migration.

audit_findings.finding: An FP-only scoreboard cannot preserve global in-order retirement if younger integer/memory operations bypass a variable-latency FP instruction.
audit_findings.resolution: Keep the first version globally blocking and non-OoO; require a separate architecture review for any general retirement structure.

audit_findings.finding: T-20260902-010 records an unrelated P7-2 Cocotb DUP/SQADD decode-overlap failure.
audit_findings.resolution: Reproduce and close it as an independent task before FP-P0 declares a green baseline; do not whitelist it.

runs.command: extract Markdown relative links from docs/FP_NEON_PIPELINE_PLAN.md and test each path under docs/
verify all 12 Make targets listed in the plan exist in Makefile

One-lane/two-lane latency, utilization, Fmax, and performance must be measured by future same-SHA tasks.
